title: Adjectives and Basic Agreement
module: Módulo 2 — Objetos, descrições e ações cotidianas
main_grammar: concordância de gênero e número dos adjetivos.

student.lets_begin: Produce at least five accurate sentences and answer at least three questions on the topic “People and objects you describe” using this lesson’s target structure.
student.basic_rule: Adjectives normally follow nouns and agree in gender and number when they have variable endings.
student.english_comparison: English adjectives usually precede nouns and never agree.

multiple_choice.instruction: Choose one option for each meaning; say the chosen sentence aloud.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “The house is beautiful.”?
Which sentence expresses “The cars are new.”?
Which sentence expresses “The book is small.”?
Which sentence expresses “The tables are beautiful.”?

gap_fill.instruction: Complete the missing target form. The English meaning is provided to remove ambiguity; read each whole sentence aloud.

mini_reading.instruction: Read the text aloud. Then answer the questions in full sentences.
mini_reading.text: A casa de Sofia é bonita e pequena. O carro dela é novo. As mesas da casa são brancas. Os livros são grandes e os cadernos são pequenos. Sofia está feliz. Os amigos dela são simpáticos.
questions: A casa de Sofia é grande ou pequena?
Os amigos de Sofia são simpáticos?
Sua casa é grande ou pequena?

review.another_way_to_understand_it: Check the noun first, then adjective endings.
review.compare: carro novo / casas novas: noun changes adjective form.

oral_substitution_drill.instruction: Start from the base sentence. Say the new sentence in Portuguese for the English cue, without writing it first.

translate.instruction: Translate into Portuguese and say each sentence aloud.

fill_in.instruction: Fill the missing form in a two-clause context; say both sentences together. The English hint gives the meaning of the second sentence.

items.sentence: As mesas são bonitas. O livro é ________.
Os alunos são altos. As mesas são ________.
A professora está cansada. Os alunos são ________.
A casa é bonita. A professora está ________.

listen_and_translate.instruction: Listen to three short utterances read by your teacher. Say the meaning in English, then repeat each utterance aloud.

reading_aloud_and_translation.instruction: Read the text aloud, translate it orally into English, then answer the questions.
reading_aloud_and_translation.text: Na escola, os alunos são altos e as alunas são baixas. A professora está cansada. O livro é novo, mas os outros livros são antigos. As cadeiras são pequenas. A sala é bonita e grande.
questions: As alunas são altas ou baixas?
Os outros livros são novos ou antigos?

speaking_practice.instruction: Answer in order: factual answers first, then personal examples and explanations. All answers are spoken in full sentences.

questions.question: Sua casa é grande ou pequena?
questions.english: Is your house big or small?

A_multiple_choice.instruction: Which sentence expresses “The house is beautiful.”? A. O livro é pequeno. B. As mesas são bonitas. C. A casa é bonita.
A_multiple_choice.worked_answer: C. A casa é bonita. — compare the exact meaning, then read it aloud.

B_gap_fill.instruction: A casa é ________. (The house is beautiful.)
B_gap_fill.worked_answer: bonita → A casa é bonita. — use the English hint and the rest of the sentence.

C_english_to_portuguese.worked_answer: O livro é pequeno. — identify the subject, choose the verb form, then say it.

D_portuguese_to_english.worked_answer: The house is beautiful. — translate the meaning, not word for word.

E_reading_comprehension.instruction: A casa de Sofia é grande ou pequena?
E_reading_comprehension.worked_answer: A casa de Sofia é pequena. — find the sentence in the text that gives the answer, then answer in a full sentence.

F_written_production.instruction: Write one new sentence with the target form, using “As mesas são bonitas.” as a reference.
F_written_production.worked_answer: Model: Os alunos são altos. — change the information, keep the target structure correct.

G_speaking.instruction: Say one sentence with today’s structure about your own life.
G_speaking.worked_answer: Model: A professora está cansada. — say it, then change one real-life detail.

your_homework.instruction: Give independent answers and speak all written sentences once.

A_multiple_choice.instruction: Choose the sentence with the given meaning.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “The cars are new.”?
Which sentence expresses “The book is small.”?
Which sentence expresses “The tables are beautiful.”?
Which sentence expresses “The students are tall.”?
Which sentence expresses “The teacher is tired.”?

E_reading.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions in full sentences.
E_reading.text: Meu quarto é pequeno, mas bonito. As paredes são brancas e os livros são novos. Minha mesa é grande. Os cadernos são azuis. As cadeiras são antigas. Meus amigos são brasileiros e americanos. Nós estamos felizes.
questions: O quarto é grande ou pequeno?
As paredes são brancas ou azuis?
Os cadernos são azuis ou brancos?
As cadeiras são novas ou antigas?

F_written_production.instruction: Write 4–6 sentences on the topic “People and objects you describe”. Use at least three different relevant examples of the target structure; add context and original details.

G_speaking.instruction: Record one uninterrupted spoken response to these three lesson prompts — Sua casa é grande ou pequena? / Seus livros são novos? / Como são suas mesas? — giving complete sentences and without reading a script.

mini_reading.translation: Sofia's house is pretty and small. Her car is new. The tables in the house are white. The books are big and the notebooks are small. Sofia is happy. Her friends are friendly.

answers.question: A casa de Sofia é grande ou pequena?
answers.answer: A casa de Sofia é pequena.

answers.question: Os amigos de Sofia são simpáticos?
answers.answer: Sim, os amigos de Sofia são simpáticos.

fill_in.full_sentence: As mesas são bonitas. O livro é pequeno.
Os alunos são altos. As mesas são bonitas.
A professora está cansada. Os alunos são altos.
A casa é bonita. A professora está cansada.

reading_aloud.translation: At school, the male students are tall and the female students are short. The teacher is tired. The book is new, but the other books are old. The chairs are small. The room is pretty and large.

answers.question: As alunas são altas ou baixas?
Os outros livros são novos ou antigos?

speaking_practice.question: Sua casa é grande ou pequena?
speaking_practice.watch_for: A casa é bonito. → A casa é bonita. (Bonita agrees with casa.) Os carros são novo. → Os carros são novos. (Plural noun requires plural adjective.)

speaking_practice.question: Seus livros são novos?
speaking_practice.watch_for: A casa é bonito. → A casa é bonita. (Bonita agrees with casa.) Os carros são novo. → Os carros são novos. (Plural noun requires plural adjective.)

speaking_practice.question: Como são suas mesas?
speaking_practice.watch_for: A casa é bonito. → A casa é bonita. (Bonita agrees with casa.) Os carros são novo. → Os carros são novos. (Plural noun requires plural adjective.)

E_reading.translation: My bedroom is small but pretty. The walls are white and the books are new. My table is large. The notebooks are blue. The chairs are old. My friends are Brazilian and American. We are happy.

answers.question: O quarto é grande ou pequeno?
answers.answer: O quarto é pequeno, mas bonito.

answers.question: As paredes são brancas ou azuis?
Os cadernos são azuis ou brancos?
As cadeiras são novas ou antigas?

F_written_production.model_text: Meu quarto é pequeno, mas bonito. As paredes são brancas e os livros são novos. Minha mesa é grande. Os cadernos são azuis. As cadeiras são antigas. Meus amigos são brasileiros e americanos. Nós estamos felizes.
F_written_production.assessment: Check length, topic relevance, at least three accurate uses of the target structure, and agreement. Personal details vary.

homework.acceptable_alternatives: A different accurate subject, name, or everyday example is acceptable in open speaking/writing tasks. For closed translation tasks, accept semantically equivalent natural Brazilian Portuguese with the target structure.
